headline: US Midterms Mark First Major Elections Under Mainstream Prediction Markets
summary: The US midterm elections are being tracked by financial prediction markets, raising debate among regulators and observers regarding political forecasting accuracy and misinformation risks.
why: Financial prediction platforms allow traders to hedge or speculate on political outcomes, creating real-time probability contracts.

impacts.name: Financial Technology
impacts.why: Increased trading volume on event-driven markets draws both retail capital and regulatory scrutiny.
